parsed.why: Enforced morality code: flogging and death for same-sex conduct, documented raids, executions and custodial rape; official advisories restrict trans public presence, forced surgery regime, forced anal tests, no recourse. Outed trans visitor faces arrest, detention, violence, possible execution.

Federal sex-binary documents, border refusal/lifetime-fraud risk on marker discrepancy, foreign-government advisories, facility bans in ~21 states, birth-sex custody with documented harm; courts partly enjoin. Universal-exposure measures with only partial working remedy — Elevated.

No criminalisation, cross-dressing legal, courts convicting attackers of trans tourists and an officer who beat a trans woman, no facility or border friction. Residual hostility and gaps in goods/services protection, but institutions work for trans victims.

No criminalisation and no documented trans-specific targeting, but zero protections or recourse, dated societal stigma, weak rule of law, no visible scene. Thin, stale evidence; structural gaps keep it mid-band rather than safe.

Decriminalised with gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime provisions on paper, but a documented pattern of violent attacks on Pride and film screenings, police failure to protect, 84% opposition and a worsening 2024 trend.
